pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

2. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.
   D. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.

4. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use The Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Bible.
   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.

5. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Cheating in exams

6. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   D. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.
   B. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)
   A. Say Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.
   D. Apply the teaching of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Skipping all moral lessons

11. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   D. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Adam and.
   B. Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Adam and to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Adam and has no place in daily life.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Easter Life of Jesus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Christian Values and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. A — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

2. A — Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

3. A — Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. C — Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. A — Telling the truth and keeping trust

6. A — Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. D — Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. A — Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. D — Apply the teaching of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ● with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. B — Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

11. B — Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. B — Apply the teaching of Adam and with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Easter Life of Jesus; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Thankfulness By the end of the Sub strand; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Christian Values; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
